summary: David knew that Yahweh was bigger than any giant, no matter how scary things looked.

story_reel.narration: For forty days, a giant named Goliath stomped out and shouted at Israel's army. Everyone was afraid. Then a young shepherd named David arrived with food for his brothers. 'Who is this giant who defies the armies of the living God?' David asked. He went to King Saul and said, 'I will go and fight him.' Saul tried to give David his heavy armor, but it didn't fit. So David took it off. He picked up his shepherd's staff, chose five smooth stones from the brook, and walked toward the giant with his sling. Goliath laughed. But David said, 'You come to me with a sword and a spear, but I come to you in the name of Yahweh!' David swung his sling, and one stone flew. Goliath fell to the ground. Everyone learned that day: the battle belongs to Yahweh.

scenes.caption: A giant shouts across the valley.

scenes.caption: 'I will go and fight him.'
scenes.art_direction: David before King Saul in a tent; Saul doubtful.

scenes.caption: 'I come in the name of Yahweh!'

memory_verse.text: Yahweh doesn't save with sword and spear; for the battle is Yahweh's

identity_focus.core_truth: Yahweh makes me brave when I face big challenges.
identity_focus.reflection_prompt: What is one 'giant' challenge you face right now, and how can Yahweh help you face it?

quiz.question: Why wasn't David afraid of Goliath?
quiz.explanation: David said he came 'in the name of Yahweh.' His courage came from trusting God.

quiz.question: What did David do with King Saul's armor?
options: He gave it to his brothers
He took it off because he wasn't used to it
quiz.explanation: David couldn't walk in Saul's armor, so he took it off and went as himself, the way God made him.

quiz.question: How many smooth stones did David pick from the brook?
quiz.explanation: David chose five smooth stones and put them in his shepherd's bag.

micro_prayer.text: Yahweh, some things in my life feel as big as a giant. Thank You that You are bigger. Help me trust You and be brave like David. The battle is Yours. Amen.

companion.message: I was just a shepherd boy, but I knew who was on my side. You don't need someone else's armor. Yahweh made you just right for the challenge in front of you.
